_readme: The DJ's vocabulary. Edit this file freely — it is data, not code, and the
booth re-reads it on every run.
A mood is a scoring rule, not a playlist. `genres` is the strongest signal
(weight 1 = a full 100 points, 0.5 = a half-hearted match). `keywords` are
matched against the folded title, artist, album and genre label, 40 points
each, so they stack. `exclude` subtracts 200 — enough to push something to
the back of the window without pretending it does not exist. `prefer` is a
nudge on duration only: 'short' likes anything under 8 minutes, 'long' likes
half-hour-plus mixes.
Genre slugs come from server/lib/genre.js and must match it exactly:
barber-beats vaporwave vgm dnb-jungle lofi jazz electronic trip-hop ambient
french-rap chanson classical rock-pop unsorted
MEASURED 2026-08-19 against the laptop library (30 files, 12.5h cycle).
Weight a mood against what is ACTUALLY there, not against what the genre
list makes possible — the first draft of this file leaned on 'ambient' and
would have matched nothing at all:
barber-beats 19 files, 50.2% of the air
vaporwave     2 files, 24.4%   (two very long mixes)
dnb-jungle    2 files,  9.7%
rock-pop      1 file,   7.6%
unsorted      2 files,  4.7%
vgm           4 files,  3.5%
ambient/lofi/jazz/chanson/classical/french-rap/electronic/trip-hop: ZERO
Re-measure with `node dj.mjs library` after the library changes.

night drive.why: Moving, but not demanding. Barber beats and liquid DnB, nothing that stops the car.

liminal.why: The long, unpeopled, slightly-wrong ambience. This is what the folder is for.

upbeat.why: Something with a pulse. Pulls the Upbeat folder and the funkier game music forward.

game.why: Video game music and the barber beats that are made of it.

study.why: Stays out of the way. No transients, nothing with words demanding attention.

short set.why: Turn the station over faster — front-loads everything under eight minutes so the hour has more titles in it.

deep.why: The opposite. Full-album and hour-long mixes to the front, for a night nobody is choosing.

vapor.why: Straight down the middle of what this library actually is.

jungle.why: Breakbeats and the atmospheric end of jungle.

french.why: The French end of the library — chanson, rap FR, and Air.
